scientific_limitations: Only the specified upper vector (1,0), zero lower vector and two-row family in the canonical coordinate Euclidean metric are proved.
The Brownian excursion and order-polytope triangulation are classical ingredients; the claimed result is their quantitative coupling to face-distance geometry.
